_comment: C3 coverage waivers (docs/COVERAGE-CRITERIA.md). Endpoints that can NEVER 2xx on the shared test account BY DESIGN. A waived endpoint leaves the C3 denominator but MUST still be C2 (called; the 4xx is the evidence). class: blast-radius | entitlement | unsatisfiable-flow | billing-prohibitive. HUMANS approve every addition (same review discipline as combo-scenarios). key = catalog endpoint key. The dashboard surfaces waived counts and flags waived endpoints that DO get a 2xx as removal candidates. | 2026-06-16 owner override: archivestorage owner-exclusion (entitlement-class) waivers DROPPED — archivestorage is now a REACHABILITY-ONLY coverage target (every endpoint CALLED regardless of 400/403/401; 4xx tolerated as access evidence), modeled in knowledge/formal/resources/storage__archivestorage.yaml; it is no longer excluded from the C3 target. | 2026-06-16 owner override: parallel-filestorage owner-exclusion (reads-only) + iam-identity-center entitlement (owner-exclusion) waivers DROPPED — both are now REACHABILITY-ONLY coverage targets (every endpoint CALLED regardless of 4xx; 4xx tolerated as access evidence), modeled in knowledge/formal/resources/storage__parallel-filestorage.yaml + management__iam-identity-center.yaml (IdC with a safety rail: synthetic/all-zero ids, no real account-level mutation). Neither is excluded from the C3 target any longer. | 2026-06-16 owner override: searchengine + vertica + sqlserver entitlement (license-gated) waivers DROPPED — all three are now REACHABILITY-ONLY (access-check-only / reachability-TERMINAL) coverage targets: every endpoint CALLED with tolerant expect [200,201,202,400,401,403,404,409,422,500], license/4xx/5xx tolerated as access evidence, no functional validation, no real license consumed, no billable-persistent cluster. They are no longer excluded from the C3 target. Functional HA/secondary validation (sqlserver Always On) stays owner-license-gated (IB-017, deferred not blocking).
